description.en: The skaa are the largest ethnic group in the Final Empire.
Luthadel is the largest Scadrian city and the seat of the Lord Ruler.
The cultural hegemony of the nobility over the skaa defines life in these regions.
Terris Dominance is a mountainous tundra at the northern edge of the Empire.
The Final Empire's control wanes in the Outer Dominances.
The largest city on Scadrial, Elendel sits on the site of the Final Ascension and is a hub for commerce and invention.
Koloss-blooded children grow up in the worlds of both peoples.
The Malwish nation is home to one of five peoples who populate the Southern Continent of Scadrial.
The outer cities encompass large population centers such as Bilming and New Seran as well as small settlements such as Doriel, Drypost, Dryport, and Garmet.
Past the mountain ranges of the Elendel Basin, the Roughs are a swath of frontier land that's desolate by comparison.
Several Terris enclaves exist across the Elendel Basin, though the largest and most influential is the Village in Elendel.
During the reign of the Lord Ruler, the kandra Homeland is an underground haven with sprawling tunnels, large caverns, and cozy chambers.
In the Final Empire, nobles conduct business and politics during lavish balls, at dining tables, and in smoking rooms.
The exploitation of the skaa has driven the emergence of a thriving underworld.
There have always been Scadrians who live a life of travel, driven by occupation, exile, or tourism.
